end.summary:
Practised choosing exact versus approximate values using wording and context.
Rounded 45,872,000 to the nearest crore; identified the crore and ten-lakh places with prompting.
Rounded 3,26,400 to the nearest lakh as 3 lakh.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised exact and approximate values, place-value positions in the Indian system, and rounding to lakh and crore. Ayaan used “lagbhag” and “exactly” to distinguish approximate from exact values, and completed the 3,26,400 rounding example after checking the next digit. At home, ask them to decide whether everyday quantities need an exact or approximate value, then round one large number to the nearest lakh or crore.
